sources.title: Wong, Siah and Lo: Estimation of clinical trial success rates and related parameters
sources.use: Clinical transition estimates depend on the event, reference class, missingness and development path. Historical 2000–2015 observations inform method rather than directly calibrating the candidate milestone priors.
sources.limit: Does not measure the probability of a small proposed milestone, attainable license, paid handoff or investor capital recovery.

sources.title: HHS/ASPE: Examination of Clinical Trial Costs and Barriers for Drug Development
sources.access: official indexed report text; direct reopening returned 403
sources.use: Clinical scope, patient count, procedures, site administration, monitoring and overhead materially affect cost. Small bridging work must not be described as a complete conventional Phase II program.
sources.limit: Historical U.S. industry averages are neither current quotations nor prices for these proposed packages.

sources.title: NIH PAR-25-059: IGNITE assay development and agent identification
sources.use: Separates preparatory qualification from subsequent agent screening and specifies decision milestones. Its funding scale is a rough scope sanity check.
sources.limit: Award ceilings are not market prices, promised funding or proof that a named project is affordable.

sources.title: NCATS New Therapeutic Uses
sources.use: Documents financial-capture difficulties of off-patent repurposing where generic forms exist.
sources.limit: An incentive problem is a screen dimension, not a universal rejection of repurposing or a candidate-specific probability.

sources.title: Parallel PR3 APR ranking audit, immutable reviewed revision
sources.access: GitHub PR content and source-linked audit
sources.use: Preserves matched APR/erlotinib evidence and warns against converting inquiry specificity into a global development rank.
sources.limit: Parallel unmerged review. Its unpriced comparison is historical; this screen adds explicitly labeled analyst estimates under the current screening direction.
